source.title: Completions of triangular matrices: A survey of results and open problems.

evidence.quote: A survey is given of recent results concerning matrix and operator completions in triangular algebras. In particular, problems of ranks, norms, singular values, eigenvalues, geometric and algebraic multiplicities, Jordan forms and spectrum assignment are considered. Open problems and conjectures are stated.
